notes.title: A small update to celebrate Debut Fest! - v0.3.1.2
notes.content:

[/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed item type icons in the techshop being clickable and wreaking havoc[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Temporary Shield ability blocking player laser attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tesla Defence System being active by default and not consuming ability charge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Side Zapper II attack visual being visible at the beginning of battles as a single line[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed profile deletion not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed continuous laser weapons ignoring range restrictions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed made aim indicator more precise[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dash button being stretched incorrectly on non 16:9 aspect ratios[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Made the game's intro cutscene be turned off by default[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked tutorial dialogue a bit[/p][/*][*][p]Moved item selling from the Workshop to the Tech Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Moved repair button from the ship panel to the shop panel[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced No Misinputs perk with Improved Target Recognition: Deal and recieve no friendly fire damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved starmap generation, so that it is less likely to encounter many stations in a row[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted combat camera movement to pan more towards pointer[/p][/*][*][p]Made primary weapon rotation indepent of ship rotation making it easier and less confusing to aim[/p][/*][*][p]Added more settings options: bloom intensity, screenshake, saturation[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notch on the ability indicator, no show the energy consumption of the ability[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a run timer, and added it to the run preview panel[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pause menu exit warning text to make it clear progress is saved[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number in the corner of the main menu and pause menu (why wasn't this already in?)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - v0.3.1.1
notes.content:
A quick hotfix addressing a bunch of stuff I wanted but couldn't fit into the last update. 

[b][h3]Important note:[/h3] Rate of development will slow down significantly in the next two months, as I have other responsibilities I have to attend to.[/b] That said, if you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, be sure to share them with me, I'll try to address them as quickly as I can.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed aim indicator line not being there in the tutorial
[*] Fixed tutorial objective indicator lingering after the objective is already complete
[*] Fixed pausing while getting back to the starmap
[*] Fixed being able to fight the final boss multiple times to farm profile XP
[*] Fixed unlocking a perk at upon beating the game causing loading error
[*] Fixed miswritten forge and workshop tooltips
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more info about the forge and workshop to the map legend
[*] Made tier 0 weapons sell for half the price of tier I weapons instead of nothing at all
[*] Tweaked sell and dismantle areas' background a bit
[/list]

notes.title: Small update adding partial gamepad support and fixes - v0.3.1.0
notes.content:
So, ladies and gentlemen, after squeezing out as much work as I could in the last few days I can proudly announce that the game has [b]gamepad support[/b] now! Well sort of... 

This is far from a complete and proper implementation, but it is a start. The game can be played fully with a gamepad, but input rebinding and glyphs indicating inputs are missing. The menu and map navigation can also be a bit tricky. But it works, so go try it out! And if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, be sure to submit them via [url=https://discord.com/invite/Ng4Ve6UeZg]Discord[/url] or the feedback button in the main menu.

Also, this update has a bunch of fixes and balance improvements, but I couldn't fix every bug and issue that came up the last few days. I'll be working on them in the coming days.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ad-hoc gamepad support
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed miswritten description for the Power Of Greed perk
[*] Fixed a few perk descriptions
[*] Fixed a few status bar tooltips
[*] Fixed side weapons targeting the final boss's shield
[*] Fixed some perks bugging out when one or all side weapons are missing
[*] Fixed lost wreckage event cutscene not ending sometimes
[*] Fixed typo on map legend panel
[*] Fixed worse player stats when starting from tutorial
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a few tooltips to the shop panel
[*] Added a couple new settings
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made a few events easier
[*] Nerfed Covert Craft mercenary
[*] Increased Federal electric weapon charge time
[*] Rebalanced Titanate and Enlightened Boss health and attacks
[*] Made Velan boss spawn a bit more mines
[*] Nerfed enemy mine damage (not by a lot mind you)
[*] Made Act III easier
[*] Swapped and tweaked Forge and Workshop sell and dismantle areas
[*] Increased player starting turning speed
[*] Increased dash upgrade's effectiveness on dash cooldown
[/list]

notes.title: Rustwing Demo Major Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo update is out![/h1]
Rustwing's demo just got a major update! It introduces new content, fixes and many general improvements! Most notably, it finally receives a much needed tutorial, an intro cutscene and exposition to the story, as well as an increased variety in combat scenarios. There are many more improvements, go check it out yourself. If you like what you play, consider wishlisting it! Also if you have anything you want to share with me, you can do it via the feedback from (accessible in the main menu).

notes.title: Rustwing Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]The Demo is out![/h1]
Ladies and gentlemen, behold: the first iteration of Rustwing's Demo is here! 
After almost 1.5 years of being in development, the game now takes up a playable form! Go try it, and if you like what you play, consider wishlisting it! Also if you have anything you want to share with the wonderful dev of this game (me), you can do it via the feedback from (accessible in the main menu).

The Demo launches as part of the Bullet Heaven Festival 2.0, go check out other games as well!
